# Every gsm machine bide's programs make (the examples/govern programs; no other
# bide code makes one, which the scan enforces), checked by the checkers
# extracted from gsm's Coq proof in the "gsm machine gate" workflow (.github/workflows/gsm-gate.yml).
# See README.md in this directory.
#
# <program> <machine> <verdict>
#
# program: a directory with a main package; the workflow runs it once, with no
#   arguments, built with -tags gsmgate, and it records every gsm machine it
#   makes. A program that reads flags, its arguments or the environment fails
#   the scan, since another run could make other machines.
# machine: the registry's name (a federation's components are listed one by one).
# verdict: certified         Build accepts it; both checkers verify it.
#          certified-tables  Build accepts it; the table checker verifies it. Its
#                            rules are closures, so the rules checker cannot run.
#          rejected          Build rejects it (WFC or CC); every checker that can
#                            run rejects it for the same reason.
#          synthesized       a synthesized repair; the table checker verifies it.
#          not-built         Build rejects it and nothing can be exported for
#                            the checkers (an invariant without a repair, left
#                            to synthesis).
#
# @doc <path> <note>       a document that shows a gsm machine (documents are
#                          listed, not run: a snippet is checked by hand
#                          against the program it copies)
#
# Nothing that makes gsm machines can be exempt: the scan fails on any package
# outside the programs below that refers to a gsm function or method making one.
#
# The gate fails if a checker rejects a machine listed as accepted, disagrees with
# Build, a program makes a machine not listed here, a listed machine is not made,
# or the scan (gsmgate -scan, which type-checks every module that imports gsm)
# finds a package making a gsm machine that is not a program here, or a document
# showing one without an @doc line.

examples/govern/authority           execution-desk  certified
examples/govern/compliance          kyc-decision    certified
examples/govern/compose             inventory       certified-tables
examples/govern/compose             shipping        certified
examples/govern/compose             order           certified
examples/govern/compose             ops             certified
examples/govern/coordination        counters        not-built
examples/govern/coordination        counters        synthesized
examples/govern/coordination        a               certified-tables
examples/govern/coordination        b               certified-tables
examples/govern/delegation          execution-desk  certified
examples/govern/earned-authority    work            certified
examples/govern/mesh                line1           certified-tables
examples/govern/mesh                line2           certified-tables
examples/govern/mesh                line3           certified-tables
examples/govern/proof-carrying-run  kyc-decision    certified
examples/govern/quorum              model-quorum    certified

@doc docs/guides/governance.md  an excerpt of the order machine (ship elided), shown as the gsm v0.11.0 Build gap; not a complete machine
@doc docs/guides/quorum.md      the model-quorum policy of examples/govern/quorum
